# Support 💬

ELTE Schedule Builder is maintained on a best-effort basis. It does not provide
an availability guarantee, response-time guarantee, or official ELTE support.

## Before asking for help

1. Check the [user guide](../docs/user-guide.md).
2. Confirm the subject code in Neptun or another official ELTE system.
3. Try the same workflow with `DEMO-1` through `DEMO-6`. If DEMO data works, the
   problem may be missing or unavailable live Tanrend data.
4. Search existing issues for the same behavior.

## Bugs

Use the repository's bug-report form. Include reproduction steps, expected and
actual behavior, browser and operating system, and a DEMO code when possible.
Sanitize screenshots and logs. Do not publish credentials, private share links,
or personal schedule information.

> [!TIP]
> A report using a `DEMO-*` subject is usually faster to reproduce and fix.

## Feature requests

Use the feature-request form and describe the user problem and observable
outcome. Note any effect on saved schedules, shared URLs, conflict detection,
calendar dates, or Tanrend behavior.

## Security reports

> [!CAUTION]
> Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Follow
> [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) so details can be reviewed privately.

## Course-data questions

This project displays data obtained from Tanrend but does not control or verify
that data. Confirm registration, times, rooms, instructors, and course
availability in official ELTE systems. The project maintainer cannot correct the
authoritative university records.
